transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 344 Whispering Falls Drive?
Sí, soy yo. Estoy bien, solo hay dos personas aquí.
How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Dos personas están aquí. Nadie necesita quedarse solo.

Gracias por confirmar la situación actual. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo. Todo está bien.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua adentro. Estamos bien, solo dos personas aquí.
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No tengo camioneta con buena altura, ni bote, ni asientos libres en un vehículo.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 2 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Sí, eso es correcto. Solo dos personas, sin agua adentro.
Gracias por confirmar, entendido. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
